threshold_rule: Choose highest validation F1 with FPR<=0.10 among 0.1,...,0.9; else lowest FPR then highest F1. Tie: higher threshold.
caveat: Exploratory fine-tuning: the authored injection families were written after observing the pretrained detector miss paraphrased payloads in run pdf_llama32_3b_01. Not a pre-registered classifier; a confirmatory PDF evaluation needs a new run ID and new payload families.
